_about: invest.py's values (AGENTS.md Rule 0). Loaded once at import and checked: a bad value logs one warning naming the key and the default used instead (the defaults are invest_defaults.json, the same values this file ships with; scripts/test_invest_config.py keeps the two equal). DENISSE_INVEST_CONFIG points at another file. Keys starting with _ are notes.

paths._about: Relative to the repo. Both are gitignored: this repo is public.

provider._about: Alpha Vantage GLOBAL_QUOTE. Free tier is end of day, so quotes are 'delayed' and a recent one is reused for reuse_hours to spare the daily quota.
provider.name: Alpha Vantage GLOBAL_QUOTE

quotes._about: stale_days: an end-of-day quote older than this (weekend + a holiday) is stale. latest_utc_offset_hours: the furthest-ahead clock on Earth, used when an exchange's timezone is unknown.

alerts._about: cooldown_hours: the same alert rule stays quiet this long after a delivered alert. delivered_kept: how many delivered alert ids are remembered.

store._about: The watchlist lock: tries lock_attempts times, lock_wait_s apart, then says it's busy.

chat._about: Exact watchlist commands, answered with no model call. Each pattern is a case-insensitive regex; {sym} stands for a ticker. A pattern must keep its capture groups (search: query; add/remove: symbol; alert: symbol, above|below, level, currency; cancel: symbol, above|below, level; alerts: none). Anything else ("should I buy X", "what is a watchlist") goes to the model.

brief._about: move_sizes: a one-day % move below 'below' (absolute) gets that word; anything larger gets move_largest. freshness_words: how each status reads in chat.

headings.observations: ## Observations (from the source named on each line)
headings.interpretation: ## Interpretation (mine, not a fact and not advice)

brief.background: Background, not advice: one company's price can swing a lot day to day (volatility); spreading money across many holdings (diversification) means no single swing decides the outcome; fees compound against you over years; and the longer the time horizon, the more room there is to ride out falls. None of this says what you should buy.

text_limits._about: Provider text is data: cut to one short line before it's shown.
